newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer amid healthy buying.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer amid healthy buying.

text.p: NWE oil products made gains across the board on Monday.
Naphtha was steady to firmer. Petrochemical buying underpinned prices with high paraffinic barrels in thin supply.
Gasoline was firmer but eased from early highs as futures markets on both sides of the Atlantic retraced Friday's gains.
Gas oil was stronger as IPE futures gained $4 despite an expected influx of U.S. barrels to the region.
High sulphur fuel barges edged up $1 a tonne but cargoes were unchanged. Demand to cover previous sales into Portugal and Ireland may boost prices. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7456
